output_text: Codex instructions for `kotlin-logging-extensions/` (default for all tasks). Repo: Kotlin Symbol Processing (KSP) plugin generating kotlin-logging extensions. Changes: optimize correctness, generated-code safety, developer ergonomics; remove logger boilerplate by generating `log` extensions at compile time. Keep processor behavior deterministic and easy to reason about. Maintain compatibility across Kotlin/KSP/kotlin-logging version combinations documented by the project. Keep processor behavior explicit and test-proven. Preserve strict module boundaries between processor implementation and workload examples. Prefer clear naming and predictable generated output over clever abstractions. Keep user-facing docs and compatibility guidance aligned with actual behavior. `processor`: KSP logic, code generation, processor unit tests. `workload`: sample consumer module for integration-style verification. `scripts`: release/maintenance scripts. Design for readers first: explicit behavior, explicit constraints, explicit failure modes. Keep generation rules stable and backward-compatible unless an intentional breaking change is requested. Add concise comments only when intent is not obvious from code. Avoid unnecessary symbol resolution and processing overhead in KSP flows. Always use the Gradle wrapper: `./gradlew ...`. `full build`: `./gradlew clean build`; `all tests`: `./gradlew test`; `processor tests`: `./gradlew :processor:test`; `workload tests`: `./gradlew :workload:test`. If generation logic changes: prioritize `
